text:
Lena (Design): quick design check: refining token create flow to make visibility explicit without adding density. pls review.
Dev (PM): tl;dr?
Lena (Design): add a tiny 'Visibility' line with radios: 'Ephemeral — shown once' and 'Recorded — stored & auditable'. default Ephemeral.
Omar (Eng): noted. Recorded implies storing readable secret in vault + audit events. infra story.
Sasha (A11y): keep 'shown once' in label text, add aria-describedby to explain audit implications. Ensure reveal drawer uses aria-live='polite'.
Lena (Design): copy tweak: change 'Show secret' ➜ 'Copy token (shown once)'. secondary action: 'Download .env (contains token)'.
Dev (PM): good. add a docs link in the success toast: 'Learn about token lifecycle'.
Omar (Eng): rotation UX: propose a 'Grace period' toggle in rotate modal. default off, if enabled default 24h. We'll emit `token.revoked.soft` vs `token.revoked.hard`.
Sasha (A11y): modal focus should land on confirm; Esc should announce 'Rotation modal closed'. toggles must be keyboard operable and described.
Lena (Design): revoke copy: replace vague 'Are you sure?' with 'Revoke token — immediately disables clients. Undo available for X hours.'
Dev (PM): Ops wants 15m undo, support wants 24h. propose: hard revoke = 15m undo, soft revoke default = 24h. security to sign off.
Omar (Eng): implementable. for inline variant we'll add two new fields on create: visibility & audit_flag. modal-only variant is lower touch.
Lena (Design): visual micro: add compact status pill on list rows: Active / Revoked (soft) / Revoked (hard). tooltip explains next steps.
Sasha (A11y): pills require text and aria-labels, not color-only. tooltips must be focusable.
ci-bot: "ci-bot: flagging epic-495 token-visibility -> needs infra/KMS review"
Dev (PM): next steps: Lena posts two small mocks (inline vs modal), Omar gives estimate by EOD, Sasha gives a11y checklist, I'll schedule security sync.
Lena (Design): will post frames in channel in ~1hr. thanks! :sparkles:
